counterexample: Unrolling S(m)=S(m/2)+10 log m gives S(m)=sum_{i=0}^{log_2 m} 10 log(m/2^i) = 10[(log_2 m +1)log m - Theta(log^2 m)] = Theta(log^2 m), which is unbounded; hence T(n)=Theta(log^2 log n), not Theta(1).
